game_title: Loop Picker – Hollow Log Trail Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about picks_right to power up the wood elf archer and open the mushroom ring.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Loop Picker
